facts.business: ACS Technologies Limited designs, builds, and delivers mission-critical technology systems for defence, government, and enterprise, including AI-driven intelligence platforms, railway safety infrastructure, unmanned systems, and space-ground integration.

capacity_or_capex.item: Chegunta campus construction for contract, on-demand and export manufacturing of drones, IoT devices and electronic assemblies

auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: Revenue recognition under Ind AS 115 identified as a key audit matter due to significant judgement in identifying performance obligations, allocation of transaction price, control assessment of third-party hardware, and measurement of progress on contracts.

key_risks: Revenue recognition estimation uncertainty under Ind AS 115
Scope variations, input price movements and execution delays on turnkey contracts
